text:
Anya Morales: :loudspeaker: Heads-up — new enforcement policy for KMS rotations on Private/VPC/on-prem. Were formalizing opt-out windows, migration SKUs, and an exec-approved exceptions flow. Posting summary and action items.

Tom Becker: Quick Q — is this tightening or clarifying current behavior? Customers have been confused about opt-outs.

Anya Morales: Clarifying + tightening. Were standardizing rotation cadence (90d default), opt-out window (until enforcement date), and requiring documented business justification for exceptions after enforcement.

Lena Ortiz: From CS perspective, customers want a clear migration path and transparent pricing. We should publish SKUs for assisted rotations and extended opt-out support.

Ravi Singh: Ops/Security notes: rotations will be zero-downtime for most clusters, but well surface a short token rewrap window (~30s) in the installer logs. HSM-backed keys: rotation requires customer HSM ops for air-gapped setups; well offer SRE-assisted rotations.

Jordan Lee: Action for CS: draft customer-facing notice + opt-out form. Include expected impacts, how to verify readiness, and contact for assisted migration. I can draft.

Anya Morales: Enforcement timeline: advisory today, opt-out window open for 60 days, enforcement hard date 2026-11-01. Exceptions after enforcement require exec sign-off + legal review.

Tom Becker: Engineering action: add opt-out flag to installer (onprem flag: --kms-rotation-opt-out until TIMESTAMP) and an audit trail. Also telemetry event when customers request an exception.

Ravi Singh: Added runbook snippet for SRE-assisted rotation: 
```
# SRE-assisted rotation checklist
1) validate key_policy: rewrap_allowed
2) snapshot auth, token refresh plan
3) apply rotation, validate rewrap logs
```

Lena Ortiz: CS pricing: propose two SKUs — "assisted rotation (one-time)" and "rotation grace (30 days extension)". Will coordinate with Sales.

Legal Bot: Note: any changes affecting encryption controls must be reflected in customer contracts for enterprise customers. Legal will prepare amendment language for opt-out exceptions and assisted services.

Jordan Lee: Draft notice link: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/announcements/kms-rotation-enforcement-draft (internal). Will tag Legal and Security.

Anya Morales: Monitoring: add dashboard tiles for rotation success rate, exceptions pending, and time-to-complete for SRE-assisted jobs. Tom — can you add alerts for exception requests > 5 in 24h?

Tom Becker: Yep — will add alert and an incidents playbook mapping. Also adding a verification CLI: `redwoodctl onprem validate-rotation --cluster ID` returns readiness info.

Ravi Singh: For FedRAMP/HSM customers, include an appendix describing manual wrap steps and expected lead time for assisted rotations (typically 2-5 business days).

Anya Morales: TL;DR action list:
- CS: publish notice + opt-out form (Jordan/Lena)
- Eng: installer opt-out flag + telemetry + dashboards (Tom)
- Security: appendix for HSM workflows (Ravi)
- Legal: contract amendment language for exceptions (Legal)
- Ops: SRE-assisted SKU runbook (Ravi/Tom)

Lena Ortiz: Ill coordinate Sales enablement and pricing drafts. Will post SKU codes here when ready.

Anya Morales: Thanks all. Please escalate any customer-impacting issues to #incidents and tag me if an exception needs quick review. Closing announcement; will post final notice after CS reviews the draft.
